instruction.text: You will hear short quotes. Listen and choose if the statements below are true or false.
instruction.sound: You will hear short quotes. Listen and choose if the statements below are true or false.

I am the most skilled student in my computer science class. My teacher encourages me to pursue a career in IT, but I've always dreamt of studying theatre. However, I'm worried that I won't live a financially stable life. I know my parents will support me either way; I'm just so torn. Should I choose a stable but boring office job or follow my passion?

atoms.a: The speaker is worried about disappointing their parents.

wrong.text: They are worried about financial instability, but they know their parents will support them.

instruction.sound: There is such a huge discussion about trans people using public bathrooms. As a trans person myself, I find it very disheartening how many people want to restrict my personal rights. I just want to use the bathroom without being bothered. I have just as much of a right to be there as any other woman.

atoms.a: The speaker is upset that other people want to prevent her from using public bathrooms.

instruction.sound: I think pets are a really great addition to someone's life. Having a pet is fulfilling in so many ways. However, I don't think children are capable of caring for them. Giving a child a pet to teach them responsibility is not fair for the animal. A pet owner should already be responsible before getting a pet.

atoms.a: The speaker thinks every child should have a pet.

wrong.text: He thinks children are not capable of giving pets the necessary care.

instruction.sound: I have been studying at university for two years and have already changed my major twice. I feel bad about not seeing anything through to the end. It feels like everyone has a plan for their life, except for me. I have no idea what I want to do in the future - I just feel lost.

atoms.a: The speaker feels he is the only one among his peers without a plan for the future.
